title: Repository State observability verification and post-merge convergence

phases.objective: Verify Repository Inventory and Repository Evaluation read-only on the exact candidate, treat their pre-merge drift as non-blocking observability, and publish deterministic repository-state outputs only after merge through the registered bounded writer.

e2e_journeys.actor: repository governance verifier and governed generated-artifact writer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: An exact pull-request candidate, exact main SHA, or governed post-merge convergence branch
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Pull-request drift remains advisory and never mutates the feature branch; stale exact-main observability emits one bounded convergence signal; the trusted writer regenerates Inventory then Evaluation on a non-protected branch and exact-head read-only verification proves the result.
steps: Checkout the exact candidate or governed branch SHA with persisted credentials disabled.
Run the v2 Repository Inventory gate and require exact-head identity plus deterministic double generation before reporting state.
Treat stale Repository Inventory as stale_observability with blocking=false and merge_blocking=false on pull requests.
Run Repository Evaluation currentness read-only and treat pull-request drift as the same non-blocking observability class.
Perform no pre-merge feature-branch mutation for either observability artifact.
After source merge, use the Repository Inventory main workflow as the shared signal for Inventory or dependent Evaluation drift because both map to repository_inventory_refresh.
Dispatch repository_inventory_refresh only from exact live main into a non-protected chore/repository-inventory-main-sync-<sha12> branch.
Inside the sole registered writer, regenerate Inventory first and Evaluation second, verify deterministic double passes and contract checks, and bound the write set to the six registered outputs.
Re-read the remote target before push, push without force, require remote result SHA readback, then dispatch exact-head read-only Inventory and Evaluation verification.
Publish the generated-output branch through the governed post-merge convergence PR path; never push generated observability files directly to main or Production.
assertions: Repository Inventory is registered as artifact_class=observability with merge_blocking=false.
Repository Evaluation is registered as artifact_class=observability with merge_blocking=false.
Pre-merge stale observability is advisory and cannot trigger feature-branch mutation.
Repository Inventory verification is exact-head, read-only, deterministic, and reports post_merge_observability_publish when follow-up is required.
Repository Evaluation verification is exact-head and read-only; bootstrap_pending and candidate-side bootstrap mutation semantics are absent.
The exact-main Repository Inventory workflow detects stale Inventory or stale dependent Evaluation and emits the shared post-merge convergence signal.
The dispatcher suppresses pull-request mutation and permits only exact-main post-merge repository_inventory_refresh delegation.
The governed writer remains the sole mutating authority for the six Repository State outputs.
Inventory generation and verification complete before Evaluation generation begins.
The writer requires exact SHA identity, rejects main and Production as mutation targets, performs no force push, and verifies the remote result SHA.
Post-merge publication occurs through a bounded non-protected convergence branch and governed pull request.
No database, provider, Production, credential, direct protected-ref, or force-push authority is granted.

phases.objective: Observe the first post-merge Repository State convergence branch and dual exact-head verification under v2 observability semantics.
blockers: The v2 source authority must first be trusted on main and exercise one bounded post-merge convergence cycle.

phases.objective: Exercise stale main identity, nondeterministic generation, dirty-set escape, branch collision, remote CAS mismatch, and verifier-dispatch failure paths.
Use the first post-merge generated-output branch as the bounded canary for repository_inventory_refresh.
Keep main and Production outside direct generated-artifact mutation targets while merged authority governs ordinary convergence branches.
